about: draft-chueayen-attestation-receipts-05 Section 8.3: the approval record an action record would reference

approval_record.format: dps-signatures 0.2.0 person_approval over dps-action-binding 0.3.0 stage o1
approval_record.canonical_bytes: RFC 8785 serialisation of the assertion object as issued

designating_policy.signed_via: the specification's policy_version, under the person's approval (shown_spec_digest and approved_spec_digest); nothing beside it is signed

binding.exact_values: the approved specification carries org_id, tool, args_hash, the policy by the digest of its bytes and valid_until; its digest is what the review showed and what the approval signed
